facts.fact: The AU/STATAFRIC peer review report on Seychelles' statistical system, published 17 October 2025 (review held 12-16 May 2025), recommends accelerating adoption of the new Statistics Bill to modernise the legal framework; no date for the bill is given, so the publication date is used.
